name: fydioo
description: Social media scheduling for businesses and marketing agencies: plan, write and schedule posts on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and X, with a person approving before anything goes out.

author.name: Lenouar Artificial Intelligence Developing Services LLC

interface.longDescription:
Fydioo is a social media scheduling tool for businesses and marketing agencies. It plans, writes and publishes posts to Instagram, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and X from one calendar, for one company or many: each company has its own channels, time zone and posting times, in English and Arabic.

This plugin brings that social media calendar into ChatGPT. It can list your companies and channels, show what is scheduled and what already went out, tell you which posts failed and why, find a company's next open posting slot, and write posts for several networks at once, with a different text for each network where it helps. It can attach a photo or a video from a public link.

You stay in charge. ChatGPT signs in with your Fydioo account and acts as you: it sees only the companies you can see and never does more than your role allows, and you choose whether it may only read, also write drafts, or also schedule. By default every post it gives a time waits in Fydioo under Queue, Awaiting approval, until a person approves it, and TikTok posts always do. It cannot approve posts, change members or account settings, connect social networks, or see API keys and passwords. You can disconnect it at any time from Fydioo, under Account, AI & API.

Fydioo records which tool each connection used and when, and marks every post an assistant writes with its name; it does not keep your conversation.
interface.developerName: Lenouar Artificial Intelligence Developing Services LLC
capabilities: List companies, channels and the posting calendar
Report what was published and what failed, with the reason
Write posts for several networks, with per-network text
Schedule posts, or send them to a person for approval
Find a company's next open posting slot
Attach a photo or a video from a public link
defaultPrompt: What is on my Fydioo calendar this week?
Draft three LinkedIn posts for next week in Fydioo.
Did any of my Fydioo posts fail to publish?

positive.description: Show what the connection can reach
positive.prompt: Which companies and channels can Fydioo post to for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the account, the company Northwind Coffee and its channels, including Demo — Northwind Coffee, and says whether posts with a time wait for approval. No company outside the reviewer's access is listed.

positive.prompt: What is scheduled on my Fydioo calendar for the next seven days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the scheduled posts with their times and channels. A post awaiting approval is reported as awaiting approval, never as scheduled or published.

positive.prompt: Did any of my Fydioo posts fail to publish recently, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the failed post and gives the reason Fydioo recorded for the channel that failed. Posts that published are not reported as failed.

positive.description: Write a post that waits for approval
positive.prompt: Write a short post for Northwind Coffee about our new cold brew and schedule it for the next open posting slot.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the post on a Northwind Coffee channel at the next open posting slot. Because the account asks for approval, it says the post now waits in Fydioo under Awaiting approval, and does not claim it is scheduled or published.

positive.description: Move a post that waits for approval
positive.prompt: Move my Fydioo post that is waiting for approval to Friday at 10:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the post awaiting approval and moves its proposed time to Friday at 10:00 in the company's time zone. It still waits for approval afterwards, and the answer says so.

negative.description: Approving a post. Approval belongs to a person in Fydioo and there is no tool for it, so it should decline and point to Queue, Awaiting approval in Fydioo.
negative.prompt: Approve the post that is waiting in Fydioo and publish it right now.

negative.description: Members and credentials. The plugin never reaches members, roles, API keys or passwords, so it should decline and direct the user to Account in Fydioo.
negative.prompt: Make my colleague an owner of our Fydioo account and show me our API keys.

negative.description: Connecting a social network. Each network is connected in Fydioo with that network's own sign-in, which an assistant cannot do, so it should decline and point to Channels in Fydioo.
negative.prompt: Connect our TikTok account to Fydioo for me.

review.commerce_description: The Fydioo plugin plans, drafts and schedules social media posts. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read the calendar, write and schedule posts across companies and networks, with a person approving.
